1. ABOUT THESE TERMS

These Terms govern your use of the Syncraft website, workspace, image-processing tools and related services provided by JAY LUIS CAÑO ("Syncraft", "we", "us" or "our"). They should be read with our Privacy Policy, Refund and Payment Policy, Copyright Policy and Acceptable Use Policy.

You must accept these Terms before creating or using an account. If you use Syncraft for a client, employer or organization, you must have authority to submit their material and agree to the applicable conditions on their behalf. A privacy notice explains our handling of personal data; accepting these Terms does not replace consent required for optional processing.

2. ELIGIBILITY AND YOUR ACCOUNT

You must be at least 18 years old, meet any higher age of legal majority that applies to you, and have legal capacity to enter this agreement. Keep your account information accurate, protect access to your sign-in account, and promptly report suspected unauthorized use to jeighdesign@gmail.com. Do not share credentials or let another person misuse your account.

3. WHAT SYNCRAFT PROVIDES

Available tools may include garment artwork extraction, logo extraction, logo creation from text, images or sketches, variations, AI edits, background removal, image upscaling, vectorization and file exports. Features depend on their availability and the workflow you select. A feature marked unavailable cannot currently be used.

The selected mode, crop, reference image, resolution and other settings affect processing. You are responsible for choosing the source area and instructions you want processed. The interface identifies paid operations and their credit cost before you start them.

Business/API access has a separate wallet and pricing from consumer workspace credits. Where a separate written business agreement applies, it governs conflicting business-specific provisions. These Terms do not remove mandatory consumer protections where they apply.

4. AI OUTPUTS AND PRODUCTION REVIEW

AI processing can change or omit colors, text, logos, fine patterns, gradients, layout or other details. It can invent elements or retain garment outlines, fabric effects or background content. Repeating a request can produce a different result. A successful processing status does not certify that artwork exactly matches a reference or is ready for manufacturing.

Review outputs before printing, sublimation, client delivery or commercial use. Check spelling, authorization, dimensions, color, placement, resolution and required file structure; make a proof or sample where appropriate. We do not guarantee an exact reconstruction, unique design, trademark clearance or suitability for a particular production process.

Resolution options describe the generated raster tier. Pixel dimensions depend on aspect ratio and processing. Upscaling and exporting can change dimensions without restoring original detail. SVG vectorization does not guarantee editable text or perfect paths, and a PSD export may contain rasterized layers. Use the actual delivered file properties to assess production suitability.

These limitations do not excuse failure to provide a paid service as agreed or remove remedies required by law.

5. CREDITS, PURCHASES AND REFUNDS

Syncraft uses prepaid credits. One credit does not equal one completed operation: costs vary by tool, selected resolution and number of outputs. The displayed total is the cost of the selected paid action. Additional paid actions or fresh generations can incur further charges.

Credits can be deducted when a request is accepted or before processing begins. Eligible technical failures are handled through the linked credit-refund or recovery process described in the Refund and Payment Policy. A credit return is different from a refund of the purchase payment.

Consumer credits currently have no scheduled expiry and are non-transferable between accounts. They are service units, not a deposit, investment or general-purpose currency. Cash refunds are considered under the Refund and Payment Policy and applicable law. Changes to future prices do not retroactively change a charge already made for a request.

6. YOUR MATERIAL AND PERMISSION TO PROCESS IT

You must own or have sufficient permission to upload and process images, text, trademarks, fonts and other material, including client files and personal data. Removing a logo, converting an image into a vector or generating a variation does not grant rights to the underlying artwork or authorize counterfeit merchandise.

As between you and Syncraft, you retain the rights you already hold in your uploads, and we do not claim ownership of your uploads or outputs. We do not promise that every AI output creates copyright or is eligible for copyright or trademark registration. Use of an output remains subject to applicable law, existing third-party rights and applicable upstream licensing restrictions.

You give us a limited, non-exclusive permission to host, transmit, reproduce and process your material as necessary to perform requested operations, show your project history, provide exports, support you, secure the service and fulfill lawful obligations. This includes necessary processing by service providers described in our Privacy Policy. It does not give us a general right to sell your artwork or publish it in marketing.

That operational permission lasts only as needed for those purposes, including necessary retention and legal obligations. Project deletion does not necessarily remove all copies instantly from provider systems or backups. Syncraft does not use your files to train its own AI models; provider processing is addressed separately in the Privacy Policy.

7. SHARING AND OPTIONAL PUBLIC DISPLAY

Where project sharing is available, the owner controls which existing Syncraft users receive view or edit access. Share only with people you trust. Paid operations performed by an authorized editor use the acting user's credits where the workflow charges that user; project sharing does not transfer a credit balance.

Project access controls and direct file links are different. Some assets are served through direct URLs; a person who obtains such a URL may be able to access the file while it remains available. Revoking a collaborator's access does not recall downloaded files or copies already shared elsewhere.

Submitting a logo for the optional community showcase requires separate display permission. Submission is subject to review and does not itself publish the logo. Approved logos and their submitted business links may be displayed publicly. You may withdraw your listing through the available controls. Participation does not by itself establish sponsorship or endorsement by Syncraft.

8. TEMPORARY PROJECT STORAGE

Syncraft is a processing workspace, not a permanent archive. Standard projects expire after three days from creation. Temporary transfer files and export caches may expire earlier. Download the files you need before expiry; editing or sharing a project should not be assumed to extend its life.

Project access expiry and physical deletion are separate processes. Storage cleanup is scheduled and can be delayed by execution failures or retries. Transaction, account, security and support records, and optional community submissions, follow different retention purposes as explained in the Privacy Policy.

Do not use Syncraft for infringement, counterfeiting, unlawful impersonation, fraud, child exploitation, unlawful disclosure of personal information, malicious code, unauthorized access, attacks on the service or abuse of payments, credits or usage limits. Where appropriate and lawful, we will explain the restriction and provide a way to raise a concern. Suspension does not automatically eliminate any refund or other right that applicable law preserves.

AI providers, networks and payment services can be interrupted. We may maintain or change features and take emergency measures to protect the service. We will provide reasonable notice of material changes where practicable, and deal with affected paid requests under the Refund and Payment Policy and applicable law.

Nothing in these Terms excludes mandatory consumer remedies or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable liability for fraud, willful misconduct or gross negligence. The AI limitations above do not waive your rights in a defective or undelivered paid service.

SYNCRAFT — REFUND AND PAYMENT POLICY
Last updated: 11 November 2026
Effective date: 11 November 2026
Operator: JAY LUIS CAÑO, operating as Syncraft
Support: jeighdesign@gmail.com

1. SCOPE

This policy explains prepaid-credit purchases, processing charges, in-app credit returns and requests for monetary refunds. Read it with the Terms of Service. Separately agreed business/API purchase terms govern conflicting business-specific provisions; mandatory legal rights still apply.

2. CREDIT COSTS AND WHEN CHARGES OCCUR

Credits are prepaid units used for Syncraft operations. Costs vary by action, selected resolution and number of outputs. The interface displays the cost before a paid action starts. One credit does not equal one generation.

Credits may be deducted when a request is accepted or before processing begins. Each requested paid action can carry its own charge. Consumer workspace credits and business/API credits use separate wallets and are not interchangeable. Consumer credits currently have no scheduled expiry and cannot be transferred between accounts.

3. FAILED REQUESTS AND IN-APP CREDIT RETURNS

If a charged request cannot deliver its result because of an eligible provider, server, processing, download or save failure, Syncraft uses the request's linked charge record to return the refundable credits or recover the already-paid result, depending on the workflow. A credit return restores service credits to your balance; it does not automatically refund the original purchase payment.

The refundable amount is the actual amount charged for that failed operation, including an older request made at a different price. For a batch, failed outputs may be refunded individually while successfully delivered outputs retain their charges. A later-stage failure may instead offer a free retry or resume of the already-paid work.

Recovery of an existing request is different from starting a fresh generation or another paid edit. The interface identifies which action you are taking. Do not repeatedly submit fresh requests solely because an earlier request is still processing.

Automated recovery or refund confirmation can be delayed. If a failed request remains charged without an available result or confirmed credit return, contact jeighdesign@gmail.com with the project or request details. We will investigate the linked transaction; you do not need to disclose your password or payment credentials.

4. OUTPUT QUALITY AND COMPLETED WORK

AI results can contain changed details, spelling mistakes, inaccurate colors, invented elements or incomplete flattening. An undesired artistic result, a poor source crop or a change of mind does not by itself trigger an automatic credit return when processing completed and the result was delivered. A fresh generation normally incurs its displayed charge.

Please report a result that was not delivered, a duplicate charge, an incorrect charge or a material failure to provide the purchased operation or selected settings. We assess those issues under this policy and applicable law. A "completed" status does not itself remove your legal remedies.

5. VOLUNTARY MONETARY REFUNDS

The following voluntary seven-day refund rules apply, subject to the mandatory legal rights described below:

- Request within seven calendar days of purchase, with no credits from that purchase used: eligible for a full refund of that purchase after verification.
- Request within seven calendar days, with some credits from that purchase used: eligible for review for a partial refund attributable to the unused portion of that purchase.
- Request after seven calendar days: ordinary change-of-mind refunds are not offered under this voluntary window.
- Credits consumed for successfully delivered operations: ordinarily excluded from a voluntary change-of-mind refund.

We check the purchase and usage records, any previous credit returns, promotional credits and any previous payment refund to avoid duplicate reimbursement. A verified payment refund may be accompanied by removal of the corresponding refunded credits. The partial-refund amount must be explained before it is finalized; a remaining account balance is not automatically equal to a refundable cash amount.

These voluntary conditions do not impose a seven-day limit on statutory remedies or prevent refunds required for an undelivered or defective service, erroneous or duplicate payment, unauthorized transaction or other legally protected situation. Account restrictions do not automatically cancel those rights.

6. PAYMENT METHODS, CURRENCY AND CREDIT DELIVERY

Use only payment methods actually offered by Syncraft's checkout. QR Ph payments are processed through PayMongo; any additional enabled method and provider will be identified at checkout. A payment method marked unavailable is not currently accepted through that control. Do not send manual payments outside the offered process on the assumption that credits will be added automatically.

The checkout identifies the package, payment currency and amount payable. International card prices can differ from PHP prices and are not necessarily direct currency conversions. Your bank or payment provider may impose disclosed or separately applicable conversion charges, taxes or fees.

Credits are added after payment is verified through the relevant provider and the Syncraft payment record. A pending, expired or unconfirmed checkout does not establish successful payment. If you paid but credits are missing, contact support with the payment reference rather than making another payment to correct the first one.

7. REQUESTING A MONETARY REFUND

Contact jeighdesign@gmail.com or the official support channel linked from the Syncraft website. Provide your account email, purchase date, amount and currency, payment reference, reason for the request and relevant project/request identifiers. Do not send passwords, one-time codes or full card credentials.

We aim to respond within three to five business days. This is a response target, not a promise that a bank or provider will complete a refund within that period. Approved refunds are normally routed to the original payment method where supported. Any necessary alternative will be discussed and verified before processing. Provider processing times and the treatment of external fees vary and remain subject to applicable law.

8. DISPUTES AND SUSPECTED ABUSE

We encourage you to contact support so that incorrect charges or missing results can be resolved promptly. You retain the right to use lawful complaint and payment-dispute channels. A good-faith dispute does not by itself justify automatic forfeiture of your remaining credits.

We may investigate suspected fraud, duplicate reimbursement, abuse of credits or unauthorized payments, and proportionately restrict affected transactions or access where necessary. We will not seek both payment and a refund reversal for the same loss without accounting for amounts already recovered.

9. YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS

Nothing in this policy limits non-waivable rights under applicable Philippine consumer law or other law that applies to your transaction. These include available remedies where a paid service is defective, undelivered or fails to conform to legally enforceable commitments. Philippine law governs this policy subject to those protections.

Personal information controller/operator: JAY LUIS CAÑO, operating as Syncraft

1. ABOUT THIS NOTICE

This policy explains how Syncraft collects, uses, shares and retains personal data in operating its website, accounts, creative tools, payments and support. It also explains your choices and privacy rights. It applies to the Syncraft service; independent sites you visit, payment providers and other third parties also publish notices governing their own processing.

2. INFORMATION WE HANDLE

Account information: Your account identifier, email, profile name and, where provided through sign-in, profile image. Google sign-in is handled through our authentication provider. We do not receive your Google password.

Creative content and project records: Uploaded images, sketches, prompts, instructions, crops, selected settings, generated and edited results, vector/export files, project titles, version history, comments and technical information needed to process, save or recover a request. Images or prompts can contain personal data about you or other people.

Payments and credits: Package selection, account identifiers, transaction and checkout references, payment amount and currency, payment status, credit charges, returns and adjustments, and relevant provider confirmations. If an offered payment flow or support investigation requires additional payer or receipt information, we process the information supplied for that purpose. Full payment credentials are handled through the relevant payment provider; do not send passwords or one-time payment codes to support.

Sharing, public submissions and support: Collaborator account details and permissions, messages and attachments you send us, feedback, and any optional community submission containing your logo, business name, website link, display permission and moderation history.

Technical information: IP address and request information, browser/device information, authentication and security records, errors, provider request identifiers, processing status and rate-limit information. If you allow analytics, additional usage information is described below.

3. PURPOSES AND LAWFUL GROUNDS

We process information necessary to provide the service you request: authenticate you, manage accounts and credits, process creative content, deliver and recover results, enable authorized collaboration, verify payments, handle refunds and respond to support inquiries. The applicable ground is generally performance of our service agreement or steps you request before entering it, as permitted by law.

We also process proportionate information for legitimate purposes such as service security, fraud prevention, troubleshooting, maintaining reliability and resolving disputes, subject to applicable law and your rights. We process records required for tax, accounting, lawful requests and other legal obligations on the relevant legal basis.

Optional analytics and optional community publication use the choices described in this notice. Where consent is required, we seek it separately; accepting the Terms or reading this policy is not blanket consent for every optional use. Do not upload another person's personal data unless you have a lawful basis to provide it for the requested processing.

4. AI PROCESSING AND MODEL TRAINING

Requested tools send the necessary reference files, prompts, settings or results to AI processing providers. This can include generation, analysis, background removal, editing, upscaling and vectorization. Authorized personnel may access relevant content where needed for support, diagnosing service faults, security, abuse investigation or legal compliance.

Syncraft does not sell uploaded artwork or generated files, and does not use them to train its own AI models. We do not treat that statement as a promise that every upstream provider has identical retention or data-use rules. Provider handling depends on the API/service, contractual terms and settings that apply to the processing. We do not promise zero provider retention or instantaneous deletion from their systems.

5. SERVICE PROVIDERS AND INTERNATIONAL PROCESSING

Depending on the feature and configuration, recipients can include:

- Fal.ai and its relevant model providers, including Google-powered models, for requested AI processing; Recraft's API for supported logo processing and vectorization.
- Supabase for authentication, databases and relevant storage; Cloudflare R2 for file storage; hosting/infrastructure providers, including Vercel, to operate the website and server requests.
- Cloudflare Turnstile and configured security/rate-limit services to detect abuse and protect the service.
- PayMongo for offered QR Ph payments, and any additional enabled payment provider identified at checkout. These providers may act independently for their own payment, fraud-prevention and regulatory purposes.
- Resend where transactional email is configured, and Google Analytics if you choose to allow analytics.

These providers may process information outside the Philippines. We remain responsible for our obligations under applicable privacy law and use appropriate safeguards for the processing and transfers we arrange. This policy does not waive those responsibilities or transfer them entirely to a provider. Information may also be disclosed where lawfully required by a competent authority or reasonably necessary to establish or defend legal claims, subject to applicable safeguards.

6. PROJECT SHARING, FILE LINKS AND COMMUNITY DISPLAY

Project owners can authorize existing Syncraft users to view or edit supported projects. Collaborators may see project material and relevant account-identifying information, such as the owner's or collaborators' email/profile details shown by the sharing interface. An editor may change a shared project within the permission granted. You control whom you invite and should only share material you are authorized to disclose.

In-app project authorization does not make every underlying file link confidential. Some images and exports are delivered through direct asset URLs. Anyone obtaining one of those URLs may be able to view or download the associated asset while it is available. Revoking a collaborator does not recall downloaded copies, cached files or links already disclosed. Avoid uploading sensitive documents or personal information unnecessary for your design task.

The optional community showcase is separate from ordinary project history. A submission requires permission to display the logo and undergoes review. An approved listing can publicly display its logo and business link; business names may appear in accessible labels or link information. Submission alone does not publish it. You can withdraw your listing using the available controls. Withdrawal stops the current public listing but cannot recall copies or screenshots made by others. Submission and moderation records may remain where needed to operate the feature or handle disputes.

7. COOKIES, LOCAL STORAGE AND ANALYTICS

Essential cookies or browser storage support sign-in, security, preferences and workspace functionality, including relevant draft/settings recovery. This storage is distinct from optional analytics.

If you choose "Accept Analytics", Syncraft loads Google Analytics to measure page views, traffic sources, approximate location, device/browser information and interactions such as tool use, generations, output counts/cost-related events and exports. We do not intentionally send the contents of your uploaded images, generated designs or prompts as analytics event payloads. Technical page addresses or identifiers may still accompany web analytics.

Choosing "Essential Only" does not initially load the optional analytics integration. You can revisit Cookie Settings in the footer to change your choice. Changing a preference affects subsequent processing where the integration supports it; it does not erase information already lawfully collected or necessarily delete existing browser cookies. You may also clear cookies/storage through your browser, which can sign you out or remove locally saved drafts/preferences.

8. RETENTION, EXPIRY AND DELETION

Standard projects have a three-day access-expiry period measured from creation. Download needed files before expiry. Temporary transfer files and export caches may have shorter retention windows.

Access expiry is not the same as immediate physical deletion. Syncraft's project-storage cleanup is designed around a three-day schedule, with separate processing for temporary assets. Actual deletion depends on cleanup execution and retries; we do not promise that every copy is erased at an exact hour. A user deletion request, provider retention cycle, cache or backup may require additional handling. Our internal project schedule does not determine every upstream provider's retention.

Account, payment, tax, credit-transaction, security and support records may be retained longer as needed for their stated purposes, legal obligations, fraud prevention and disputes. Community submissions use separate storage and do not automatically follow ordinary three-day project expiry. Browser-local drafts and preferences may remain until replaced or cleared by you or the application. We review continued need and delete or de-identify records when no longer necessary, subject to applicable law.

9. YOUR RIGHTS AND CHOICES

Subject to applicable law and its conditions, you may request information about processing, access or copies of your personal data, correction, erasure or blocking, objection to processing, data portability where applicable, and withdrawal of consent for optional processing. You may also raise a complaint with the National Privacy Commission and pursue remedies available under law.

Contact jeighdesign@gmail.com to make a privacy or account-deletion request. We may reasonably verify your identity and clarify the scope to protect your information, without asking for unnecessary sensitive documents. We will explain any lawful reason a request cannot be fully granted. Withdrawal of consent does not affect earlier lawful processing, and some records may need to be retained to comply with law or resolve claims.

10. SECURITY AND AGE REQUIREMENTS

We use access controls, authentication, encrypted network transport and other appropriate measures to protect information. No online system is completely risk-free. File-link exposure, authorized sharing and copies made outside Syncraft should be considered separately from account-access controls. We address incidents and provide notifications where required by applicable law.

The service is intended for users who satisfy the age requirements in the Terms, including a minimum age of 18 for the integrated AI service. If you believe a child has supplied personal data contrary to those requirements, contact jeighdesign@gmail.com so we can assess and take appropriate action.

11. CONTACT AND CHANGES

Personal information controller/operator: JAY LUIS CAÑO, operating as Syncraft
Privacy and support requests: jeighdesign@gmail.com
National Privacy Commission information and complaint channels: https://privacy.gov.ph/

This policy is effective from 11 November 2026. We will communicate material changes through appropriate channels. If new optional processing requires consent, we will seek it before relying on that consent.
